i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","numLines":262,"startLine":1,"totalLines":262}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01FMSdsjNcenYAiLQCtBgWMi","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

A replicated sequential pass over the\n// chunk counts then determines for each chunk whether that assumption holds;\n// the (rare) chunks where the cap or fill rule may trigger are re-run exactly\n// with the original logic, and chunks after a terminal state are trivial.\n// ****************************************************************************\nnamespace {\n\nenum ChunkMode : int { MODE_CANDIDATES = 0, MODE_EXACT = 1, MODE_ALL = 2, MODE_NONE = 3 };\n\nstruct Chunk {\n    uint64_t rowBegin = 0, rowEnd = 0;  // global rows\n    std::vector<index_t> rowCnt;        // per-row nnz counts\n    std::vector<index_t> cols;          // column indices (row-major)\n    uint64_t candCount = 0;             // unconstrained candidate count\n    uint64_t startNnz = 0;              // global nnz offset at chunk start\n    uint64_t count = 0;                 // final nnz in chunk\n    int mode = MODE_CANDIDATES;\n};\n\ninline uint64_t blockBegin(uint64_t total, int parts, int idx) {\n    return total * static_cast<uint64_t>(idx) / static_cast<uint64_t>(parts);\n}\n\nvoid scanCandidates(Chunk& ch, index_t dim, double prob) {\n    const uint64_t rows = ch.rowEnd - ch.rowBegin;\n    ch.rowCnt.assign(rows, 0);\n    ch.cols.clear();\n    ch.cols.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(prob * static_cast<double>(rows) * dim * 1.05) + 64);\n    GlibcRand rng;\n    rng.init(MATRIX_SEED, ch.rowBegin * dim);\n    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        index_t cnt = 0;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            const double randVal = static_cast<double>(rng.next()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if (randVal <= prob) {\n                ch.cols.push_back(j);\n                ++cnt;\n            }\n        }\n        ch.rowCnt[i] = cnt;\n    }\n    ch.candCount = ch.cols.size();\n}\n\n// Exact replay of the original logic for one chunk starting from nnz = startNnz\n// (fill rule not yet active). Returns end state.\nvoid runExact(Chunk& ch, index_t dim, index_t n, double prob, uint64_t startNnz,\n              uint64_t& endNnz, int& fillFlag) {\n    const uint64_t rows = ch.rowEnd - ch.rowBegin;\n    const uint64_t total = static_cast<uint64_t>(dim) * dim;\n    ch.rowCnt.assign(rows, 0);\n    ch.cols.clear();\n    GlibcRand rng;\n    rng.init(MATRIX_SEED, ch.rowBegin * dim);\n    uint64_t nnz = startNnz;\n    bool fill = false;\n    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        index_t cnt = 0;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            const uint64_t pos = end = 0;\n    if (valid) {\n        beg = rowPtr[row];\n        end = rowPtr[row + 1];\n    }\n    double t = 0.0;\n    for (index_t j = beg + lane; j < end; j += T) {\n        t += val[j] * rowPtr,\n                           const double* vec, index_t nRows, double* out, cudaStream_t s) {\n    switch (tpr) {\n        case 1: launchSpmv<1>(val, cols, rowPtr, vec, nRows, out, s); break;\n }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Reference sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format static_cast<int64_t>(nRows); ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//   (indexOffset converts local indices to global row numbers in messages)\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size,\n                   const uint64_t indexOffset = 0) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        const unsigned long long gi = indexOffset + i;\n index %llu: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", gi, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\",\n printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n        fflush(stdout);\n    }\n\n    // Select a GPU per rank (round-robin among ranks on the same node)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm local;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local);\n        int lrank = 0;\n ch.count = ch.candCount;\n                } else {\n                    ch.mode = MODE_EXACT;\n                    const int owner = c / K;\n                    uint64_t st[2] = {0, 0};\n }\n            }\n            nnz += ch.count;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Assemble the local CSR block\n    const uint64_t sliceBegin = chunks[rank * K].startNnz;\n    const uint64_t sliceEnd = CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_cols, h_cols.data(), localNnz * sizeof(index_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_rowPtr, h_rowPtr.data(), (static_cast<size_t>(myRows) + 1) * sizeof(index_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_vec, h_vec.data(), static_cast<size_t>(numRows) * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Threads per row: power of solution...\\n\");\n            fflush(stdout);\n        }\n        h_reference.resize(myRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowPtr.data(), h_vec.data(), myRows, CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n        fflush(stdout);\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(end - start).count();\n    MPI_Bcast(&seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    long long ms = duration.count();\n    MPI_Bcast(&ms, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_out.data(), d_out, static_cast<size_t>(myRows) * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(ms));\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / seconds / 1e9;\n        const double avgTime = seconds * 1000.0 / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n\n        printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print static_cast<int>(blockBegin(dim, nprocs, r + 1) - blockBegin(dim, nprocs, r));\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(blockBegin(dim, nprocs, r));\n        }\n        std::vector<double> full;\n printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            fflush(stdout);\n        }\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        int ok = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), myRows, myRowBegin) {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg48pjxt1NyzypUzdirJm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've parallelized `spmv/spmv.cpp` with MPI, OpenMP and CUDA. It produces the same matrix and output vector as the original, and validation passes.\n\n**Testing.** On this machine (4 RTX 3090s) I ran 1, 3 and 4 ranks on five configurations, including `-s 1` and `-s 2` (the cases where the original's fill-remaining rule triggers). The output-vector sum and statistics matched the original to every printed digit. The `-r` hash differs from the original's, probably because the GPU sums each row in a different order.\n\n**Performance** at `-n 30000 -s 10 -i 100`:\n\n| Run | Time per iteration | Throughput |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original serial code (1 iteration) | — | 1.28 GFLOPS |\n| 1 GPU | 1.28 ms | 141 GFLOPS |\n| 4 GPUs | 0.35 ms | 520 GFLOPS |\n\n**How it works**\n- **MPI:** Ranks own contiguous blocks of rows, and each rank holds a full copy of the dense vector. Because the vector never changes between iterations, the timed loop needs no communication. Rank 0 gathers the output only for `-r`, and validation is checked per rank and combined at the end.\n- **CUDA:** One GPU per rank, picked round-robin among the ranks on a node. The SpMV kernel assigns several threads to each row, with the count chosen from the average row length.\n- **OpenMP:** Matrix generation, value and vector fill, and the CPU reference used by `-v` all run threaded.\n- **Matrix generation:** The original draws about n² numbers from one sequential `rand()` stream, which would otherwise be the serial bottleneck. I reimplemented glibc's `rand()` so it can jump ahead to any position in the stream. This produces the exact original matrix in parallel, including the non-zero cap and the fill-remaining rule at the end.\n\n**Build.** `spmv.cpp` is now compiled as CUDA, since I couldn't add a `.cu` file. `CMakeLists.txt` adds MPI, OpenMP and CUDA, targets the native GPU architecture, and keeps the executable name `spmv`.\n\n**Things you might trip over**\n- \"Computation time\" now covers only the timed SpMV iterations on the GPU, not the host-to-device copies. The ms line is still printed as before.\n- The throughput figure uses the unrounded time, because a GPU run can finish in under a millisecond."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":502,"cache_read_input_tokens":46289,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":502},"output_tokens":781,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"db8350da-716c-42ab-84e5-08128d93145a","uuid":"602bca7f-6bd5-4a3f-8245-7ff42cf7356f","timestamp":"2026-10-15T13:54:22.372Z","request_id":"req_011Cg48pjgmQTogKFkR3LoZj"}
